notes.title: V.1.7 Update
notes.notes:
- New attraction (Feeding Enclosure)
- New sandbox maps with different map sizes and themes
- Bugs fix
- Bigger outdoor area on some levels
- Higher point production for ocean scavenger and offices

Thank you and let us know again if there is any more feature you like to see.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
A new big update has been released, offering new features and gameplay:

- Custom made attractions
- Upgrading object system
- New aquarium tank type
- New species
- VIP visitor challenge and reward
- Bigger utility area for building filter, heater and others
- Faster research time

Thank you for the feedback and let us know again if there is any more improvement you like to see.

notes.title: New update and version
notes.notes:
Added few updates.

- More fish species
- New aquarium tank
- More reward for catching criminals
- Wall builder mode
- Visitors costume change when using some attractions

Let us know if there is any more new feature request. 

Thank you.
